description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'EmployeeSalaryComponentAPI' within the OrangeHRM project. It manages CRUD operations related to employee salary components, including retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting salary component records. The class includes methods for validation rules, handling direct deposit details, and integrating with other services and models in the project.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryComponentAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class handling CRUD operations for employee salary components within the OrangeHRM HRMS system, including validation and direct deposit handling.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific employee salary component based on employee number and component ID.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all salary components for a specific employee, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and adds a new salary component for an employee, including optional direct deposit details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee salary component's details.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes specified employee salary components based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for retrieving a specific salary component.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for listing salary components.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for creating a new salary component.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating a salary component.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Defines validation rules for deleting salary components.
